m: One huge *sweep* of the leg carries you across the puddle in a single **long stride**.
Grip the *brush handle*, dip the soft tip in ink, and draw with your **writing brush**.
Pound grain on the *drying rack* with a *slide* of a heavy stick: the cook's **pestle**.
A *plank* lid lies off to one side and a *boot* has kicked out one wall: an **open crate**.
A *slide*, another *slide* and a third *slide* hang side by side like the **bristles** of a brush.
Strike the *plank* hung from the watchtower each hour of the night, and it booms like a **gong**.
Under a rocky *roof* two *curtains* of vines hang over the dark entrance of a **cave**.
Put a *plank* top on a *post on ground* and you can hammer away at your **workbench**.
A *pole* lies flat on the floor with its head under a hat: a **lying man**.
Hang *two sparks* of water off a long *cross* handle, scooped up with a **dipper**.
Lift the *lid* off a box and look down: every side is equal, a perfect **square**.
Bend a stick into a *snake bend*, tie a string across it, and you have a **bow**.
A tiny *bullseye* body with wriggling legs and a long tail: a crawling **bug**.
A *standing person* holds out a hand and a little bird with short tail lands: a **sparrow**.
A *fish hook* yanks a fish out and spray flies off both sides: **splashing water**.
A *plank* lies across a grave under a pale *dusk moon*, and up climbs a rattling **skeleton**.
One flat *plank* of a parting and strands flowing down past the shoulders: **long hair**.
A *drop* of a flower is laid on a *hiding box* in the ground, marked by a **tombstone**.
A *person* spreads poles in a cone and a *drop* of smoke curls out the top: a **teepee**.
An *awning* of rock hangs over a *mouth* of a hole: a hard grey **stone**.
Hang a *towel* from a *plank* pole and wave it high above the crowd like a **banner**.
Push a *little fortune stick* up from a *plank* floor and follow it to go **upstairs**.
A *river* runs between upright stakes joined by a *plank* rail: a **picket fence**.
A *big man* tilts his head with a little *slide* and spins on his toes like a **dancer**.
Two shoots wrap round a *pole* and knot together as a **twisted vine**.
Lean a *moon*-shaped frame on a *plank* step and climb it: a **stepladder**.
Clip a hedge into the shape of a *tattoo* so every leaf is level: a **trimmed hedge**.
A *ribbon* trails behind a runner while a hand makes a *sweep* to grab it: the **chaser**.
The *scissors* cut the case in two and a *drop* of ink signs the verdict: the **judge**.
A *mouth* of a frame stretched with knots and cords: a **fishing net**.
A *left hand* pats the earth and a *slide* of a leaf pokes up: a **green shoot**.
Drops spatter on a *banner* stretched across the sky: it is pouring with **rain**.
Under the *awning* of his chin hangs a *dangling beard*, long and grey: an old man's **beard**.
Bend an *elbow* into the mud under an *archway* and you leave a **paw print**.
Stand poles upright on a long *plank* and climb up: a builder's **scaffold**.
A *cross* of twigs snapped off by a *right hand*: a leafy **branch**.
Lay *two planks* on a stand and scatter *crumbs* below as an offering: the temple **altar**.
Under the *lid* of a little *shed* lies a fevered patient on a **sickbed**.
Set a *plank* on top of an *inner room* of three legs: a cooking **tripod**.
An *eye* looks down the long bridge to a *drop* at the tip: your own **nose**.
A *slash* of iron bent into a *swoop* at the end: a **crowbar** to prise things open.
Swing a *scythe* through *two planks*, with a *slide* and a *drop* of sparks flying: **twin blades**.
Two hills open like *curtains* and a stream runs out below: a deep **valley**.
Fold a *plank* of paper around a box, twist the end, and hand over a **gift**.
A long *plank* of a back on bent legs, mane flying: a galloping **horse**.
Under the *lid* of a collar the *robe hem* swishes along the floor: a silk **robe**.
Under a *slanted cap* a hunched *swan*-necked figure holds out a bowl: a **beggar**.
Under the *teepee* a *boomerang* hand sweeps round and round, ticking now: a **clock**.
A *plank* of lips blows and a *snake bend* of mist drifts out: a **puff of breath**.
A *lying man* stretches flat and a *sweep* of the leg marks his length: a **ruler**.
Wind thread over and under a *plank* until it fills a wooden **spool**.
Hit it with a *crowbar* and a *drop* rolls out, small and round: a **pill**.
A *drop* of a handle sits above a *lying man* stretched like a panel: a **door**.
Put a *drop* at the feet of a *big man* and he grows even bigger: a **giant**.
A *family tree* grows down to a *drop* of stone at its bottom: the **foundation**.
Stand on a *plank* below the *scaffold* of the top step: second place, the **silver medal**.
Pull up your *hood*, tuck your *hairdo* in, and carry home a full **shopping basket**.
A *bent knife* of light cuts over a coiled *python*, painting it every colour: a **rainbow**.
One *spoon* beside another *spoon*, the same shape facing the same way: **twins**.
A *long comb* in one hand and a *pole* in the other, ruling the town: the **magistrate**.
Wrap a strip of tanned hide round and round a *pole* and buckle it: a **leather strap**.
A *slash* of a pin goes straight through a *heart* to hold it on the board: a **pinned heart**.
An *axe* hits a rock and a *drop* of metal flies off its edge: a **chipped axe**.
Under a *slanted cap* of a purse, shiny **gold coins** clink together.
One pair of *scissors* above another pair of *scissors*, criss-crossing: a woven **lattice**.
A *pole axe* with an extra *plank* of blade across it: a heavy **battle axe**.
A *ski* curves down and folds into a *bracket* at the waist: a **bowing man**.
Lay one *plank* on top of *two planks* and count them: **three planks**.
A *dangling beard* drips soup down onto a *plank* table: catch it in a **dish**.
Take a few *crumbs* between your fingers, then a *slash* knocks most away: just a **pinch**.
Wave a wand at a *tree* and a *drop* of light appears beside it: a **magic trick**.
A *slash* across the middle of a tall body, below the neck and above the legs: the **torso**.
A *ski* bends sharply backwards like a man glancing over his shoulder: a **turned head**.
A *sun*-round belly sits on a *tall stool*, sloshing with red wine: the **wine jug**.
Cut down a *pole* of stalk with *three planks* of ears on it: a sheaf of **wheat**.
A *sunrise* glows over a flat *plank* that stretches as far as the eye can see: the **horizon**.
A *husband* fires a *slide* of a shot that sails off and is never found: a **lost arrow**.
A *slash* of sharp white curves down from the wolf's jaw: a **fang**.
A *slide* of a tip bends over a *bent cross* stem and sways: a **grass blade**.
A *shelf bracket* cut from a log, flat and thin: a **wood slice**.
A *slide* of claw above scattered *rice*-shaped prints in the snow: **animal tracks**.
Peel back the *covered mouth* of a pod, and *antlers* of shoots sprout from a **bean**.
A flat *plank* of a nose with two holes, sniffing and snorting: a **pig snout**.
A *slide* of breath rushes through a little tube and out comes a shrill **whistle**.
Lay a *plank* across the road, stand guard beside it with a halberd: a **guard post**.
Pull up your *hood* and roll the cloth down to your *ankle*: a long **bolt of cloth**.
Grind clay with a *pestle*, pile it like a *mountain*, and fire it into a **clay jar**.
A *slide* of a comb runs through soft hairs on a cat's back: thick **fur**.
A *glare* across the table and a *drop* of sauce: someone stole your **good meal**.
A *small table* tipped on its side with a *drop* of a flag: hoist it as a **sail**.
A *plank* of a tail flaps under a scaly body: a slippery **fish**.
Hold the *brush handle* and mop up the *splashing water* for your master: the **servant**.
A *bent cross* of stripes across a crouching head ready to pounce: a **tiger**.
Kneel in front of an *open crate* of papers and bow to the king: his **minister**.
A *bent knife* cuts a slice, a *ski* slides it onto a plate: a **side dish**.
A *pole*, a *pole* and another *pole* lying side by side, all flowing downhill: a **river**.
A *bracket* of a desk and a *covered mouth* that gives orders: the **boss**.
Push a *drop* of seed into each square of the tilled frame: the **seedbed**.
Stretch the hide over a *grass basket* to dry in the sun: tough **rawhide**.
A *boot* sticks out from under a long dark cloak, hand held out: a **cloaked beggar**.
Climb the *podium*, bite into a *cross*-shaped red pod, and scream: a hot **chili**.
Three hooked nails close round a *pole* and grip: an eagle's **talon**.
Tie back the *curtains*, then take the *scissors* to cut the hedge: that is **father**.
A *single wing* beside another *single wing*, soft and striped: a pair of **feathers**.
The *embers* go out and leave the chimney full of black **soot**.
A *fish hook* drops into the middle and ripples spread on both sides: **water**.
A *swan* skims past a *cross* marker on the lake, very **swift**.
Throw your hair back over your *elbow* and it streams in **flowing locks**.
*Footsteps* from one road meet a *single footstep* from another: the **crossroads**.
A round *mouth* of a knee above a bent *ankle*: the whole **foot**.
A *cliff* of shell opens a crack and a tongue slides out: a **clam**.
A *knife* with a *drop* of light on its sharp side: the **blade edge**.
One foot points to the *dusk moon*, the other copies it with *mirror feet*: **dancing feet**.
A *window* stacked on a *window* stacked on a door, rising high: a **tower**.
A *drying rack* with a *fish hook* at the bottom to hang your coat: a **coat stand**.
Under the *shed* roof a *grove* of tall stalks dries for rope: **hemp**.
A *sapling* oozes sap, and a *slide* of a brush spreads it glossy red: **red lacquer**.
A *swan* neck of white mist rises out of the kettle: **steam**.
A *spoon* of a tail flicks, scales gleam, and smoke pours from its nostrils: a **dragon**.
Lift the *covered mouth* off the pot on three fat legs and stew bubbles: a **cauldron**.
